Borrow the tool, skip the purchase

Most drills in a household run for thirteen minutes in their whole working life. The library keeps one good drill on the shelf for the whole street instead, and the catalog lists every tool with its condition notes and the last date it was serviced.

How lending works

Pick a tool from the shelf list, bring it back within seven days, and note anything that wore out. Members who return late simply skip one turn; the opening hours are the only schedule anyone has to remember.

Opening hours

Tuesday and Thursday evenings from six to eight, and Saturday mornings from nine until noon.

Reserve a tool

Run by volunteers on Alder Row. Questions go to the front desk during opening hours.
